ingredients.title: Bread
items: 2 cups raw apples, grated or chopped
Mix all of the bread ingredients together until moistened.
Divide into 3 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake at 350°F for 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.
*The original recipe calls for shortening instead of unsalted butter and applesauce, so that works well also.
